dfx.example.expect: rows, one per loan, soonest maturity first, with lender, principal and rate, plus `population` stating how many loans DFX holds
dfx.example.goal: Every confirmed commercial loan maturity in one state, lender named.
dfx.example.note: Free. At most 200 loans per call.

annotations.title: Confirmed commercial mortgage maturities for one state

description:
Free, keyless and unauthenticated.
Returns the LOAN rather than the event: for one US state and one forward window, up to 200 loans with maturity date, original and current principal, interest rate, lender name, instrument type, origination date and the secured property's address, deduplicated to one row per loan and ordered by maturity.
Narrow the state to one county (`county`) or to a metro's counties (`metro`, a CBSA code or name such as 'Dallas-Fort Worth-Arlington'); a county or metro answer also counts the loans in the state whose property carries no county. A CMBS lender is the originator code as filed (SG, WFB) with the parent lender's name beside it (Societe Generale, Wells Fargo).
Every maturity_basis is 'confirmed': 23,921 of 23,921 loans carry a date filed with the SEC by a servicer or recorded by HUD, and none is estimated or inferred from a term length.
Every response states how many loans DFX holds for the filter and whether the delivery is complete, so an answer capped at 200 rows is never presented as the whole population. Each row says whether a maturity event was published for the loan. A missing event does not mean the loan is defeased: loans filed as defeased (ABS-EE code F, or IP for a portion) are withheld, and code X means defeasance is not allowable, so an X loan must refinance or pay off at maturity.

county.description: Optional. One county in `state`, by name: 'Dallas' or 'Dallas County'. Matches the secured property's county as filed.

metro.description: Optional. A metro (OMB core based statistical area) as a five digit CBSA code ('19100') or a name ('Dallas-Fort Worth-Arlington', 'Boston'): the metro's counties inside `state`. A metro crossing a state line is served one state per call and the answer names the other states. An unknown or ambiguous name is refused with the candidates.

within_days.description: Forward window from today. Default 548, eighteen months.
